Count of six-digit numbers divisible by \(13\):
\[
\left\lfloor \frac{999999}{13}\right\rfloor-\left\lfloor \frac{99999}{13}\right\rfloor
=76923-7692=69231.
\]

Count divisible by \(17\):
\[
\left\lfloor \frac{999999}{17}\right\rfloor-\left\lfloor \frac{99999}{17}\right\rfloor
=58823-5882=52941.
\]

Thus
\[
a-b=69231-52941=16290.
\]

\[
\boxed{16290}
\]
